WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(cs.points) as race_avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_points) as avg_points,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as avg_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as global_avg_wins
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.country,
  ca.avg_points,
  ca.avg_wins,
  ca.avg_wins - gm.global_avg_wins as wins_minus_global_mean
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.country;

assumptions.assumption: Only races with at least one constructorStandings record contribute to the per-race averages; races with no standings are excluded. This is a natural consequence of the JOIN operation and the data structure.
